title: Micro contrib effort estimate — quick rundown
content:
Purpose: quick, spreadsheet-style rundown to estimate minimal contributor hours to cover a short cross-team surge window (Fri 18:00 — Mon 09:00).

Scope: one-off coverage for feature rollout risk window (canary -> gradual). Not a long-term roster bake; goal is a pragmatic, smallest-safe headcount.

How to use: skim rows below to assign owners, then ping backups. Numbers are coarse (30–90% confidence) and include a 20% buffer for handoff/context. If a team cannot supply the owner listed, replace with the backup and increment the estimated hours by +25%.

Quick table (columns: Team | Primary | Est hours | Backup | Confidence | Notes):
- Hosting & Infra | Marcus Ortiz | 8.0 | Priya Raghavan | medium | GPU autoscale watch; 2x escalation paths if burst fails
- Serving Runtime | Ben Cho | 10.0 | Elena Vasile | low | KV cache warmup risk; heavy tail of long sequences expected
- Observability | Lina Huang | 6.0 | Omar Siddiqui | high | Dashboards + alert thresholds; quick playbook for paging
- Product Ops | Asha Patel | 4.0 | Miguel Torres | high | Coordination, rollout throttles, canary gating
- Customer Success | Priya Raghavan | 3.5 | Zoe Kramer | medium | CS triage, customer comms template prewritten
- Platform Engineering | Derek Mills | 5.0 | Shweta Rao | medium | Network egress checks, regional routing sanity
- SRE / Oncall overlap | Oncall rotation | 6.0 | Next-on-call | high | Regular oncall processes pick up paging spikes

Total estimated contributor-hours (baseline): 42.5
With 20% buffer: 51.0 hours

Quick risk notes and mitigations:
- Risk: autoscale lag creates request queueing -> Mitigation: pre-warm minimal burst nodes (Marcus).
- Risk: model variant mismatch fallback triggering higher-cost executions -> Mitigation: temp routing to older variant + brief rollback window (Product Ops to coordinate).
- Risk: alert noise drowning true signal -> Mitigation: Observability to mute non-actionable alerts and surface 5 critical signals.

Decisions to make before handoff (checkbox):
- [ ] Confirm each primary owner can take 1x 4-hour block during window
- [ ] Share single Google sheet with live phone/pager numbers
- [ ] Bake one-line escalation templates into Slack sidebar (ops/playbook)
- [ ] Confirm cost-accounting tag for increased egress/compute during burst

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally minimal. If any team wants an expanded hourly rota (with exact timestamps), I can generate a per-24h shift grid; feedback welcome in-thread.

Quick provenance: assembled 2027-06-12 from sprint leads and last-run artifacts; numbers drawn from recent small-rollout on 2027-05-07 (OPS-3678).
